walkthroughs.body_html:
Absolute poverty: cannot afford food, water, shelter — common in some countries.

Relative poverty: have basics but well below average — common in the UK.

About 14 million people in the UK live in poverty.

Roughly 1 in 4 children.

Use of food banks has risen sharply since 2010. 🥫

Causes of UK poverty:

  • Low wages.
  • High rent and bills.
  • Job loss or illness.
  • Cost-of-living rises.

It affects school grades, health and mental wellbeing.

mcqs.q: What is the difference between reliability and validity in research?
options: Reliability is whether a method produces consistent results when repeated; validity is whether it actually measures what it claims to. A method can be reliable but invalid, or valid but unreliable.
Reliable research is published in journals; valid research isn't.
Reliable and valid mean the same thing — that the research is good.
